text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, just a little more… If I can just keep this simmering until morning… on the night of… a full moon…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'll have… the most… in…credib…le po…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although the fire fortunately went out on its own, Sweep Tosho is upset that she burned her special magic potion.
